data.title: Binghatti Amber
data.about:
Discover the luxurious blend of innovation and tradition at Binghatti Amber. Choose from studios, 1 to 3 bedroom apartments that perfectly capture the essence of upscale living.

Binghatti Amber's design is a visual treat, with intertwined balconies creating a dynamic façade. These unique balconies not only offer residents a private outdoor haven but also optimize energy efficiency with their shading effect.

Every detail echoes Binghatti Developers' signature style, a blend of contemporary designs infused with traditional Middle Eastern nuances. Positioned in a prime location in JVC, Binghatti Amber stands as both a lavish home and a smart investment for the future. Dive into an unparalleled blend of luxury and practicality!

characteristics_module.title: Unveiling Modern Elegance in JVC
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime location in the coveted Jumeirah Village Circle
  • Perfect balance of tranquility and urban convenience
  • Swift access to major Dubai landmarks, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina
  • Epitome of the developer's signature design excellence
  • Modern exterior aesthetics seamlessly melding with the surrounding
  • Luxuriously crafted interiors with an eye for detail
  • Apartments featuring high-end finishes, premium fixtures, and panoramic city views
  • Array of top-tier amenities, from a pristine swimming pool to a cutting-edge fitness center
  • Tranquil green spaces for relaxation
  • Specialized children's play area for young residents
  • Close to a vibrant mix of retail, dining, and leisure spots
  • Community events fostering a tight-knit neighborhood spirit

location_tile.title: Binghatti Amber's Premier Location in JVC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Tucked within the lively realm of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Binghatti Amber boasts a stellar position amidst Dubai's pulsating core. Recognized for its serene atmosphere, verdant landscapes, and unparalleled city links, JVC is a coveted locale. Inhabitants benefit from proximity to educational institutions, medical centers, retail destinations, leisure spots, and essential transit routes, promising an enriched and effortless way of life.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 10 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Internet City
  • 15 Minutes to DIFC
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Media City
  • 15 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
